notes.title: v1.23 Update
notes.notes:
v1.23
Chinese translation for in-game dialogue and UI, Steam Store Page, and Steam Achievements

Steam Deck compatibility tested - works out the box ːsteamthumbsupː

Dabbing near NPCs elicits a response from them

OST released as DLC

Language select on Title Screen when first running game

Title Screen tweaks: more animation, cleaned up UI, big clickable button for Wishlisting Episode 2

Replaced the embedded full game browser version on itch.io with v1.23 demo build

Minor bug fixes

More details with pictures in Announcement

notes.title: v1.22 Update
notes.notes:
v1.22
Fixed cutscene black bars on 21:9 aspect ratio screens to display correctly

Added 'Pause Subtitles' Option to keep subtitles on screen until click

Fixed Bru grabbing bone direction, forces Bru to face correct direction

Fixed bathroom door hotspot that was appearing over bath after door was opened

'Meditation Hero' instructional text remains for longer on screen

Fixed fridge door closing if left open when leaving and re-entering lounge

Added Bru pose of looking at Mr. Bergie's business card after receiving it

Fixed bug in full game where final cutscene might stop running after receiving achievement
